title: Observable Transit Forecast Transfer
goal: From a noisy light curve and a file of future observatory visibility windows, recover the planet period and transit epoch, then compute which predicted transits fall inside the allowed windows and write the observable events to /root/observable_transits.json.
skillBenefitRationale: The only nontrivial scientific step is estimating a reliable transit period and T0 from the light curve, which is exactly what transit-least-squares provides; the follow-up window matching is simple downstream logic.
